description: Default factor scoring and weighting tables for groundwater recharge potential screening

slope.description: Slope steepness in degrees; flatter terrain favors infiltration

soil_permeability.description: Soil permeability proxy from SoilGrids or field data
soil_permeability.scoring_notes: Higher values indicate more permeable soils

geology.description: Geological formation type ranked by permeability

land_cover.description: Land cover type ranked by infiltration favorability

drainage_density.description: Drainage density; lower density favors infiltration over runoff

rainfall.description: Annual rainfall amount; more rain provides more recharge source

references: Saaty, T.L. (1980). The Analytic Hierarchy Process. McGraw-Hill.
Bonham-Carter, G.F. (1994). Geographic Information Systems for Geoscientists. Pergamon.
Singh, S.K. et al. (2013). Groundwater potential zoning in GIS environment. J. Geol. Soc. India.
Yeh, H.F. et al. (2016). GIS for the assessment of groundwater recharge potential zone. Sustainability.
